correctness.rationale: C: For edge BC (length a), the active sector is B−π/2<θ<π/2−C of length A, with W=a cosθ. Three sectors partition unoriented angle space of total π. Taking inverse derivatives on monotone subarcs yields exact density terms 1/√(s²−t²) on their appropriate intervals. For acute, each side contributes two inverse-square-root singularities (total weight 6); right triangle has hypotenuse2 and legs1 (total4); obtuse has only longest side with weight2. In obtuse case the negative density jumps at h_b,h_c cannot cancel, and their positions recover b,c by a h_a=b h_b=c h_c, including repeated altitudes. Thus any triangle side multiset recoverable, leading to SSS congruence. Independent uniform-angle projection grids of 180001 directions tested CDF across acute/right/obtuse examples, without replacing analytic sector proof.
residual_risks: Nondegenerate Euclidean triangles, uniform unoriented line directions, ideal exact probability density with one-sided limits.
